answer: Locks are published in nebula, expire in nectar, and basalt lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 134 aliases therefore needs 155 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 94 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
